The '''Abafar Extraction Conglomerate''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] company. It had been mining the reserve of [[Rhydonium/Legends|rhydonium]] located at the [[Scarred Plains]] of [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]] until it had eventually run dry.
